blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court on Wednesday ruled that a corporate lawyer testifying in Vice President Sara Duterte’s unexplained wealth case cannot selectively invoke attorney-client privilege to withhold information concerning two companies linked to the Vice President. Presiding Officer Francis Escudero allowed lawyer Suzette Balucanag-Punay, corporate counsel of GenCorp Industries, Inc. and Metro […]...
